rationale: The claim is a study-bound empirical observation about Qwen 2.5 base versus chat bias. None of the supplied meta-principles addresses the specific mechanism by which post-training can introduce geopolitical bias independently of pre-training data composition. The candidates concern bias-variance trade-offs, identifiability, missing data, data ceilings, inductive bias, scaling, and triangulation, none of which has a compatible variable or condition relation to this finding. The claim is sound within its stated boundary but has no compatible foundational root in the provided list.
